portfolio.statement: BANDHAN ULTRA SHORT TERM FUND holds an ultra-short-term debt portfolio weighted across certificates of deposit, debentures, commercial paper, treasury bills, and reverse repo liquidity as of October 31, 2026.
interp: The portfolio has a primary concentration in bank and financial institution certificates of deposit and corporate debentures.
Liquid reserves and sovereign paper are maintained via reverse repo (6.06%) and 182-day treasury bills (4.10%).
portfolio.line: Short-dated debt allocation concentrated in financial sector CDs, debentures, and commercial paper alongside sovereign paper and cash.

drivers.text: Certificates of deposit across HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and NABARD aggregate to 21.40% of the disclosed portfolio.

Corporate debentures from SIDBI and Tata Capital Housing Finance account for 10.19% of the fund.
